question: Can the physical Saturn PLC HMI become an ordinary deterministic C23 target without creating a second authored UI model?
hypothesis: If canonical Presentation lowers to inspectable C23 through one small satgui port ABI, the same authored model can serve Web/report/PLC while legacy FBD screens disappear from the rich-HMI path.
evidencePlan: compile generated source with the real Saturn C23 SDK once the satgui port binding is available
execute the C23 target ABI in Firmverse and compare deterministic 320x240 frames

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: Rich Saturn PLC HMI should compile into FBD screen records
negativeKnowledge.condition: Saturn PLC C23 exposes the display through libsatstd/satgui and supports physical keyboard input

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: The browser should own an independent React HMI implementation for the PLC screen
negativeKnowledge.condition: The emulator must consume the same generated C23 target contract as the physical target

validity: Applies to the Saturn PLC 320x240 physical target after the conventions-first BuildArtifact boundary.
